method_notes.denominator: All cases independently annotated by both C and D; no case is dropped on the basis of an annotation outcome.
method_notes.ordinal_weighted_kappa: Quadratic-weighted kappa calculated only when both annotations have a valid ordinal value; IE/NA/blank excluded.
method_notes.multilabel: Exact set agreement, mean Jaccard, mean set F1, and macro one-vs-rest labelwise Cohen kappa.
method_notes.free_text: No content kappa; only coded-vs-IE/NA-vs-blank status agreement.
